title: Motion Machine brand half (SPEC §3): the look

fictional.description: true for every shipped preset (AXIOM 3); false for a captured or hand-written real brand

source.description: where a captured brand came from; never a URL that the piece would load

surfaceInk.description: text on a surface (cards, panels, tiles, caption bars, device screens); ink when absent

composition.description: the grid and type hierarchy are part of the brand. Layouts take their default alignment and headline size from these; a beat's align param still overrides

align.description: default alignment of every layout (the kit exposes it as --mm-align: start or center)

headlineScale.description: multiplier on every layout headline (--mm-headline-scale); 1 is the reference hierarchy

density.description: spacing between a layout's blocks and its side indent (--mm-density: airy 1, compact 0.6)

accentText.description: false for a brand that never colours text: every pattern that would tint text with the accent uses ink (--mm-accent-text); accent fills are unchanged. Default true

devices.description: how device frames (phone, laptop, browser) are finished; optional, ink by default

finish.description: every finish is a palette role: ink, canvas (the surface), graphite (the darkest role), silver (the lightest)

ground.description: what sits behind every scene; optional, a flat canvas by default. Blobs are blurred shapes in the brand's own colours (added to the palette G-LITERAL checks), placed and sized by shares of the frame; the mark is a picture centred and scaled past the frame, faint

x.description: left edge, share of the frame width

y.description: top edge, share of the frame height

w.description: width, share of the frame width

h.description: height, share of the frame height

blur.description: blur radius, share of the frame width

src.description: relative path from the piece page; never a URL (SPEC §2.6)

width.description: width, share of the frame width; above 1 the mark is clipped by the frame

finish.description: the surface look, each strength 0 to 1 and optional. Overlays above the scene; whatever can lie over text stays at or under 0.08 opacity

grain.description: film grain in ink, seeded from t at 12 Hz; like halftone it darkens the background a little, which W-CONTRAST measures

halftone.description: a fine dot screen in ink

vignette.description: the corners darken toward ink; inside the safe area it stays at or under 0.08

edgeFringe.description: a soft accent glow along the frame's edge, outside the safe area

paperEdge.description: a rough surface-coloured border inside the frame's edge, within the safe margin; it is a frame border, so W-BAN warns unless the brand lists `frame-borders` in `allow`

ask.description: fields a capture could not measure (fonts from stills, for example), to be confirmed by hand; W-ASK warns while any remain

allow.description: bans this brand lifts, by name

src.description: relative path inside the repo or the piece; never a URL (SPEC §2.6)
